title: Trade

blocks.heading: Trade
blocks.text: Trade is exchange of goods and services, commonly through buying and selling. International trade crosses national borders. Exports are sold abroad; imports are bought from abroad, from the perspective of the economy being described.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Use the evidence
blocks.text: Suggest a trade response for a fictional producer with surplus dried fruit and a nearby buyer needing it, with safe transport available. Arrange a viable sale with agreed quality, quantity and payment. Exchange connects the surplus to the buyer’s demand under the stated transport conditions.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated
